body.title: Diagnose disabled GitHub CI and preserve PDF review evidence
body.body:
## October 30 authorized CI activation — HOLD

Repository Actions is now enabled for the existing Pull Request Tests workflow. All six specified operational workflows remain disabled; read-only token defaults and disabled automated PR approval are unchanged.

Independent GitHub CI failed:
- PR #44, head `922f1f8f8c66ef14674eb9aa20db144a45dada68`, tested merge `183398e54172058472184f1704f32c4cda8033a4`: **764 passed, 5 failed, 157.49s**. [Run 41060138183](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/actions/runs/41060138183).
- PR #45, head `6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a`, tested merge `295456f93c6fdfcfcf2d65b9f61d73733ca319a2`: **803 passed, 6 failed, 165.43s**. [Run 41060143806](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/actions/runs/41060143806).

Both ran on Ubuntu 26.04 / Python 3.11.17. Safety and migration gates passed. Week 7 diagnostic replay, Week 8 audit/research replay, and additionally PR #45 Week 9 context replay failed. Exact mismatch causes remain unresolved; earlier Windows passes do not override these failures. Logs and configuration receipts are retained locally in the CI merge-gates worktree under `outputs/2026-ci-merge-gates/20261030-authorized-activation/`; no new source push or rerun follows the stop condition.

All 125 protected artifact hashes and the source database hash still match. No application/model/policy/security changes beyond the explicitly authorized activation; no operational run, merge or approval. **HOLD #44, #45 and #46** pending a valid repair, successful exact-tree GitHub CI and an independent non-author APPROVED review. No independent reviewer has been designated. #46 has no independent run.

---

Prior description retained below for provenance; the October 30 CI failure status above supersedes earlier CI status statements.

Repository-level Actions is disabled even though the existing Pull Request Tests workflow is active. This explains the zero recorded runs on #44 and #45. The PR preserves authenticated API evidence, exact-head local tests and dependency/hash verification, and adds clean PDF reading copies while keeping every original source byte.

Objective and root cause:
- GET actions/permissions returned HTTP 200, enabled:false at 2026-10-29T21:38:50Z.
- Existing CI workflow 328094886 is active and present on main; PR-open events exist; repository-wide run count is zero.
- Token defaults remain read-only; automated PR approval is false. Main has no branch protection/rulesets. No repository security setting or workflow trigger has changed.
- Proposed CI activation requires owner approval: first disable the six non-CI workflows, then enable repository Actions, preserve token/security defaults, and trigger the existing CI via PR reopen events. Production scheduling must remain disabled.

Exact reviewed heads:
- #44: 922f1f8f8c66ef14674eb9aa20db144a45dada68 — 769 passed, 39 existing warnings, 195.39s; eight read-only safety/migration/audit gates pass.
- #45: 6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a — 809 passed, 39 existing warnings, 210.81s; eleven read-only gates pass.
- Both executions record HEAD before/after, empty tracked diffs, timestamps, cwd, commands and log hashes. These are local Windows Python 3.12.14 runs, not GitHub Ubuntu/Python 3.11 CI.
- This repair implementation is committed at 6cefac6402799daf964b5d1175145ba26a83b853. Its complete suite passed: **818 tests, 39 existing warnings, 166.11s**, with clean tracked diffs and HEAD recorded before/after. Nine focused adversarial tests also passed in 1.25s. Evidence-delivery head is **8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4**, eight additive verification files after the tested implementation; no full suite is claimed on that later evidence-only head.

Files and behavior:
- scripts/pdf_evidence_review.py creates a separate three-file reading-copy version and manifest, rejects original PDF/extract hash changes, requires exact deterministic verification, and refuses any existing output directory.
- tests/test_pdf_evidence_review.py adds nine tests for preserved source bytes, source tampering, forged/missing/extra output, and attempted overwrite. No existing test changes.
- docs/CI_ACTIVATION_PROPOSAL.md and docs/CI_MERGE_GATE_RECONCILIATION.md explain the diagnosis, safe activation, exact commands, limitations and merge gates.
- outputs/2026-ci-merge-gates/20261029-investigation contains API responses, ancestry/protected hashes, run provenance/logs and reading copies.
- .gitattributes adds one byte-preserving rule for that new evidence directory. No schema, dependency, application/model/weekly policy change. v2.8 is unchanged.

Whitespace: the entire main-to-#45 diff contains 6,421 findings: 6,419 in the three PDF extracts, one historical Week 7 note and one checksum-pinned Week 8 audit-code line. Originals remain unchanged. The native full-diff check remains exit 2 and is NOT relabeled as passing. Clean reading copies address readability; no blanket ignore or unrelated-failure suppression is introduced. The incremental repair diff passes git diff --check.

Verification commands (repository .venv Python; complete commands/provenance in the report):
```text
python -m pytest -q
python scripts/verify_repo_safety.py
python -m scripts.verify_migrations
python -m scripts.verify_cloud_migrations
python -m scripts.verify_week7_audit_integrity
python -m scripts.seal_week8_board --verify
python -m scripts.build_week8_postgame_audit --verify
python -m scripts.week8_scoring_sequence_review --verify
python -m scripts.week8_numerical_research --verify
python -m scripts.seal_week9_board --verify
python -m scripts.review_week9_context --capture outputs/2026-week9-context/20261029T1147Z-thursday-gate --verify
python -m scripts.verify_week9_owner_review outputs/2026-week9-owner-review/20261029-morning-decision/owner_review_shortlist.json
python -m scripts.pdf_evidence_review --create
python -m scripts.pdf_evidence_review
python -m pytest tests/test_pdf_evidence_review.py -q
git diff --check 6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a HEAD
```

Data integrity: all 125 protected Week 8 audit/research, Week 9 prospective and saved owner-review files match the recorded #45 blobs. Week 8's 52 ATS/52 totals grades replay; Week 9's 54 ATS/54 totals seal and ten-candidate review pass. Original source DB hash remains 09d0bcda684356001bacf8bc9e42939add56b053f405564d9be924e39c0cf842. No historical close is fabricated; CLV remains INCOMPLETE.

Dependency order: repaired aggregate #41 (contains #35–#40), then #42; #43 and #44 are sibling branches after #42 and can follow in either order; #45 includes both; this repair follows #45. Never merge unrepaired predecessors independently. Recheck the actual merge tree if main changes.

Current shortlist remains Northwestern +3.5 (2), Navy +30.5 (2), Southern Miss–ULM Under 56.5 (2), SMU–Syracuse Under 58.5 (1), Troy +20.5 (1); FAU–UNT Under 77.5 is alternative six. Owner approval is PENDING. All prior versions and original mixed research ordering remain intact.

Recommendation: HOLD #44, HOLD #45, HOLD this repair until independent CI and review are satisfied. Only owner JCRABURN is currently listed as collaborator; owner-authored COMMENTED reviews are not independent APPROVED reviews. An independent reviewer username and any needed owner-managed access are outstanding. No merge or approval has occurred.

Rollback: leave this branch unmerged or revert only its additions and new attribute rule, preserving evidence in Git history. No database recovery. If later-authorized activation needs rollback, disable repository Actions before restoring the non-CI workflow states. Original repository, root NFL work, secrets and unrelated files remain untouched.

[Final verification and exact run provenance](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4/outputs/2026-ci-merge-gates/20261029-investigation/FINAL_VERIFICATION.md) · [CI activation proposal](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4/docs/CI_ACTIVATION_PROPOSAL.md) · [Complete report](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4/docs/CI_MERGE_GATE_RECONCILIATION.md)

Final incremental inventory relative to #45: **37 added files and one modified file (.gitattributes), no deletions**. All original source/artifact bytes remain intact. No GitHub CI or independent approval is claimed.
